title: GrowthBook footer (v2)
description: A navy footer: wordmark, a short description, a row of pale social icons and two round outline compliance badges on the left; five tidy link columns on the right (with an optional small violet 'new' tag); a mono copyright and legal links along the bottom. Phones fold the columns into a two-up grid.
notes: always uses the theme's dark colours (dark class)
social icons come in as props (lucide 1.x has no brand icons)
name: growthbook-v2-footer

props.name: brand
props.description: the wordmark, drawn larger than in the header

props.name: blurb
props.description: one or two sentences under it

props.name: socials
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon: ReactNode; }[]

props.name: badges
props.description: round outline badges, e.g. compliance marks; each line is a line of text

props.name: copyright
props.description: the mono line at the bottom left

props.name: legal
props.description: the mono links at the bottom right
